baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱعْلَمُوا and the predicate شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ at words 1 and 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative demands recognition, شَدِيد supplies force and tight attachment, and عِقَاب supplies the punitive outcome that follows an act. The warning is therefore causal and temporal: a deed can acquire a firmly bound aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Literal disclosure to a knower makes recognition the commanded act and frames the mechanism as something to be consciously grasped.
Literal tightening of a bond supplies the firmness with which consequence is functionally attached to conduct.
Literal ending and outcome supplies the temporal tail in which the deed's consequence appears.
Literal punishment after an offense identifies that following outcome as accountable punitive response.

changed_reading.before: A generic warning that God can punish intensely.
changed_reading.after: An instruction to recognize that action can carry a firmly attached punitive aftermath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired predicates غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ at words 8-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: غفر supplies covering that protects an offender from the effect of a fault, while رحم supplies tender beneficence toward the one under care. The second pole is active release and preservation, not merely a softer divine mood.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering of a fault and protection from its effect supplies the interruption of punitive aftermath.
Literal tenderness, sympathy, and beneficence supplies positive care for the released person.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and mercy are general assurances after the threat.
changed_reading.after: The verse also names an active operation that covers fault, shields from its effect, and tends the person preserved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated construction أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ at words 2-3 and 6-7 gives both clauses the same subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: The full divine name is repeated rather than leaving the second clause implicit. Severe follow-through and protective release are therefore co-present operations of the same worshiped One; neither clause cancels, delegates, or temporally replaces the other.

activation_trace.role: Literal worship and the worshiped One identifies the repeated subject whose single authority holds both operations.
Literal punitive response after offense supplies one live operation of that authority.
Literal protection from a fault's effect supplies the distinct releasing operation of the same authority.
Literal compassionate care prevents release from being reduced to bare non-enforcement.

changed_reading.before: The verse juxtaposes two portraits that must be harmonized into one average disposition.
changed_reading.after: It keeps two irreducible operations simultaneously available within one accountable relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 5:87, human prohibition of what God has released is itself placed beside transgression. Severe consequence therefore cannot be recruited to maximize restriction: the paired attributes protect an authorized boundary against permissive breach and against devotional over-tightening.

activation_trace.role: Literal tightening supplies the severity that this context prevents readers from reproducing as unauthorized rule-tightening.
Literal punishment after offense remains the focus consequence whose target is recalibrated by the context.
Literal protection from an effect keeps lawful life available inside the guarded limit.
Literal prohibition supplies the human restrictive act that the ayah explicitly forbids.
Literal dissolution of a prohibition supplies God's release of the good things from human restraint.
Literal crossing of a limit identifies excess itself, including restrictive excess, as the breach.

structural_cues: 5:87 places do-not-prohibit, God's making-lawful, and do-not-transgress in one sentence before the focus.
The food and conduct sequence of 5:87-93 repeatedly joins lawful enjoyment to guarded obedience rather than to maximal abstention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, release, and limit-crossing; I infer that the focus severity guards the authorized line in both directions. A live alternative is that 5:87 corrects only one local ascetic excess and does not establish a general symmetry.

changed_reading.before: Fear of severe punishment recommends the most restrictive available rule.
changed_reading.after: Knowing severe consequence also requires refusing unauthorized austerity; mercy and lawful good remain within the protected limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The expiation of 5:89 gives covering a reparative social body: liability is covered through feeding, clothing, or liberation, and 5:95 explicitly adds release of what has passed. Focus forgiveness can thus be heard as protective covering that may restore damaged relations through material acts rather than as private cancellation alone.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering of fault and protection from its effect is the focus operation given material analogues by the context.
Literal beneficence directs the covering toward another person's concrete welfare.
Literal erasure of sin by covering supplies expiation as the context's explicit liability-covering mechanism.
Literal feeding of another turns covering into nourishment directed toward social need.
Literal placement of a cover over something makes material protection an enacted image of repaired liability.
Literal freedom opposed to bondage makes liberation a further reparative form of the covering.
Literal leaving of punishment and erasure of fault confirms that the reparative sequence can terminate liability.

structural_cues: 5:89 offers feeding, clothing, liberation, and fasting as alternative expiatory paths.
5:95 again places compensation before the declaration that God released what had passed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expiatory covering, welfare transfers, liberation, and pardon; I infer that these legal acts instantiate a human-scale analogue of focus forgiveness. A live alternative is that expiation merely discharges formal liability and should not be generalized into a model of divine action.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is a private declaration that removes a penalty.
changed_reading.after: Protective covering can have reparative form: it feeds, clothes, liberates, and then releases past liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The chain in 5:95 runs from deliberate action through equivalent recompense and experienced harmful weight, then from pardon of the past to renewed action and punishment after disapproval. This makes the focus pair a temporal gate: consequence is calibrated to agency, pardon can close the earlier account, and deliberate return reopens punitive follow-through.

activation_trace.role: Literal force and hardness supplies the intensity of the consequence whose conditions the context specifies.
Literal outcome supplies the temporal consequence generated at the end of the legal sequence.
Literal deliberate intention supplies the agency threshold for the ensuing liability.
Literal response to an act with its recompense supplies consequence as answer rather than arbitrary impact.
Literal equivalence supplies proportional calibration to the reparative response.
Literal experiential testing makes the harmful result something the actor must encounter rather than merely hear about.
Literal injurious heaviness supplies the felt weight of the act's consequence.
Literal abandonment of punishment and erasure closes the account concerning what preceded.
Literal return after departure supplies recurrence as the event that reopens liability.
Literal punishment following disapproval supplies the renewed punitive response after recurrence.

structural_cues: Within 5:95, deliberate killing precedes equivalent compensation and tasting the act's burden.
The same ayah then orders pardon of what passed before return and renewed punitive response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the chronological chain and its response terms; I infer that it locally specifies when the focus aftermath attaches, closes, and reattaches. A live alternative is that these are separate hunting rules and should not delimit the broader divine predicates.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and forgiveness are two static, competing outcomes.
changed_reading.after: They form a temporal protocol: a proportioned consequence answers deliberate action, pardon closes the past, and deliberate recurrence reattaches follow-through.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, 5:97 makes protected places, times, offerings, and visible markers a support by which people stand, and gives this order an epistemic purpose. The focus pair can therefore function as maintenance operations: severe follow-through makes marked limits credible, while forgiveness and mercy keep the standing order reparable rather than terminal.

activation_trace.role: Literal punitive response after breach supplies enforcement for the marked protected order.
Literal protection from fault's effect supplies a route for damaged membership to remain reparable.
Literal sanctity, protected claim, and inviolability supplies the public limits maintained by the focus pair.
Literal support, subsistence, and that by which something stands supplies the social function of the protected order.
Literal neck-marker or ornament supplies a visible sign by which protected status becomes publicly legible.
Literal disclosure and knowing supplies the stated epistemic purpose that flows directly into the focus command to know.

structural_cues: 5:97 immediately precedes the focus and repeats the أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ construction before 5:98 repeats it twice.
The preceding ayah calls the sanctuary complex قِيَامًا لِّلنَّاسِ and then says ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marked sanctities, public support, and a purpose of knowing; I infer that punishment and forgiveness are complementary maintenance operations for that order. A live alternative is that 5:98 is only a general doctrinal coda after the sanctuary rules.

changed_reading.before: The predicates are an isolated list of divine traits.
changed_reading.after: They can operate as a charter for keeping a protected public order credible, standing, and repairable.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:99 denies any informational gap by pairing divine knowledge with what people disclose and conceal; 5:101 then warns that disclosure can harm, records pardon, and repeats غفور. Focus forgiveness is thus informed restraint or protective non-exposure under full knowledge, while the command to know does not license compulsive inquiry into everything coverable.

activation_trace.role: Literal disclosure to the knower anchors the focus command whose scope the later warning about inquiry qualifies.
Literal covering and protection from an effect supplies forgiveness as deliberate shielding rather than ignorance.
Literal appearance and emergence supplies the disclosed side of material already under divine knowledge.
Literal hiding and covering supplies the concealed side that divine knowledge equally reaches.
Literal asking and seeking supplies the human act capable of forcing harmful disclosure.
Literal emergence supplies the potentially painful result of unnecessary inquiry.
Literal erasure and leaving punishment supplies an informed decision not to press the exposed matter.
Literal covering of fault and protection from its effect repeats the focus operation inside the disclosure warning.

structural_cues: 5:99 follows the focus by stating that God knows both what is made manifest and what is concealed.
5:101 links asking, harmful manifestation, pardon, and the predicate غفور in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete knowledge, harmful disclosure, pardon, and repeated covering; I infer that mercy can choose non-exposure despite knowing. A live alternative is that 5:101 concerns needless legal questions only and does not establish a general ethics of concealment.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness may occur because an offense remains hidden or overlooked, and knowing more is always safer.
changed_reading.after: Fully known material may be deliberately covered and pardoned; human knowing is bounded where compelled disclosure itself would injure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene limits creaturely knowledge, extends divine watching beyond a witness's tenure, and finally places if You punish beside if You forgive over servants under wisdom. The focus imperative therefore commands modest knowledge of two real divine capacities; it does not give humans the hidden case knowledge needed to decide which capacity governs another person.

activation_trace.role: Literal knowing anchors the limited human instruction that the closing judgment scene differentiates from exhaustive divine knowledge.
Literal punishment after offense supplies one outcome held open for informed judgment.
Literal shielding from a fault's effect supplies the other outcome held open without cancelling accountability.
Literal knowing is contrastively distributed between the messengers' admitted limit and the divine knower of hidden matters.
Literal guarding and surveillance supplies continuous divine oversight after creaturely witnessing ends.
Literal painful punishment supplies the first conditionally stated adjudicative outcome.
Literal servitude and ownership locates the judged persons under divine authority rather than human possession.
Literal covering and protection from consequence supplies the second conditionally stated outcome.
Literal sound, accurate wisdom supplies the competence by which the two outcomes are adjudicated.

structural_cues: 5:109 has the messengers say that they possess no knowledge before naming God knower of hidden matters.
5:116-117 contrasts knowledge of inner selves and time-bounded creaturely witness with continuing divine watch.
5:118 preserves punishment and forgiveness as parallel conditional possibilities rather than selecting one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetrical knowledge, continuing watch, servants, conditional punishment or forgiveness, and wisdom; I infer that exhaustive case assignment belongs to God alone. A live alternative is that the closing scene concerns only its named historical witnesses and does not constrain ordinary human judgment.

changed_reading.before: The command to know the two attributes equips readers to predict which pole applies to other people.
changed_reading.after: Readers must know both capacities, while the watched inner case and final assignment remain with the wise divine judge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because requested evidence normally appears only to comfort belief, yet it remains anchored in ٱعْلَمُوا and severe عِقَاب through 5:113's desired certainty and 5:115's punishment after subsequent truth-covering. Render it as a local evidence-accountability dynamic, not as a claim that ignorance generally excuses wrongdoing or that seeking knowledge is blameworthy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The command ٱعْلَمُوا at word 1 and punitive aftermath عِقَاب at word 5.

activation_trace.role: Literal disclosure to a knower anchors knowledge as the threshold whose consequences the outlier explores.
Literal punishment after offense anchors the heightened accountability that follows acquired certainty.
Literal settled reassurance supplies the intended benefit of receiving the requested sign.
Literal knowing supplies explicit certainty as one requested result of the sign.
Literal covering of truth supplies the post-evidence rejection that activates the severe result.
Literal after-position supplies the decisive sequence: rejection occurs after the requested disclosure.
Literal painful punishment supplies the unusually intensified aftermath attached to post-sign rejection.

changed_reading.before: Additional evidence only reduces uncertainty and exposure.
changed_reading.after: Requested evidence can settle the heart while also increasing accountability for a later deliberate covering of what became known.

strongest_changes: Severe عِقَاب became a calibrated temporal aftermath, especially where deliberate recurrence follows pardon.
غفور رحيم became materially reparative and knowingly protective rather than a merely private or uninformed cancellation.
The context blocked severity from justifying unauthorized restriction and situated the pair within maintenance of a marked public order.
The command to know raised accountability while the closing judgment scene withheld final case assignment from limited human knowers.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly turned an apparently static threat-and-comfort formula into operations across time, law, public boundaries, disclosure, and judgment without collapsing punishment into mercy or mercy into leniency.
remaining_uncertainties: How far the expiation mechanisms should be treated as analogues of divine forgiveness rather than only formal legal discharge.
Whether the public-order reading is intended by the immediate 5:97 transition or is only a productive contextual extension.
Whether the evidence-raises-exposure outlier is local to the table episode or expresses a broader knowledge-accountability principle.
